aviation_incidents.headline: UPS貨機與Copa客機邁阿密滑行相撞　737翼尖撞上767機鼻、2人輕傷
aviation_incidents.summary: UPS航空一架波音767貨機與Copa航空一架波音737客機，週六晚間在邁阿密國際機場滑行時相撞。美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）表示，Copa客機的翼尖撞上正在滑行待起飛的767貨機機鼻。碰撞發生於當地時間晚間約9時15分，地點在兩條滑行道的交會處。Copa航空427號班機為波音737-800，甫自巴拿馬城托庫門國際機場抵達，正滑向登機門；UPS358號班機為波音767-300F，正滑行準備起飛前往波哥大。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: UPS Boeing 767 and Copa Boeing 737 collide while taxiing at Miami airport
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A UPS Airlines Boeing 767 freighter and a Copa Airlines Boeing 737 collided while taxiing at Miami International Airport on Saturday night. According to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), the wingtip of the Copa passenger jet struck the nose of the 767 as the cargo aircraft taxied for departure. The collision happened at approximately 9:15 p.m. local time at the intersection of two taxiways. Copa flight 427, a Boeing 737-800 that had just arrived from Tocumen International Airport (PTY) in Panama City, was taxiing toward its gate, while UPS flight 358, a Boeing 767-300F, was taxiing for departure to Bogota.

international_aviation.headline: IATA：近半空難調查未公布最終報告　飛安教訓難以傳開
international_aviation.summary: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）指出，依國際規則調查的空難中，近半數至今未公布最終報告。IATA飛安總監馬克·瑟爾（Mark Searle）表示，最終報告的公布率長期維持在約50%，在11月12日蒙特婁國際航空安全高峰會上稱此一停滯令人無法接受。IATA警告，報告付之闕如使航空業難以辨識危險因子、預防類似事件重演。
international_aviation.headline_en: IATA: nearly half of air accident investigations still lack final reports
international_aviation.summary_en: Nearly half of air accidents investigated under international rules still have no published final report, according to the International Air Transport Association (IATA). IATA safety director Mark Searle said the publication rate has remained close to 50%, describing the lack of progress as unacceptable at the International Aviation Safety Summit in Montreal on November 12. IATA warns that the shortfall limits opportunities to identify hazards and prevent similar events.

new_information: The CE-25A fixed-wing electric commercial aircraft completed its first piloted test flight on November 14, 2026.
The CE-25A, developed by state-owned aerospace manufacturer COMAC, is designed to carry up to 19 passengers plus crew.
The aircraft took off and landed in Binzhou, Shandong province, southeast of Beijing.
Two pilots and a flight test engineer were on board.
The aircraft spent 16 minutes and 38 seconds in the air.
According to Chinese state media, the aircraft had been flying for months, with 19 uncrewed flights completed.
